# Match checked-attribute syntax to presence-based consumers

Current folder popup helpers use item.toggleAttribute("checked", !!checked), and pause-update commands consume hasAttribute("checked"). A literal checked="false" still has the attribute. When a control state is read by presence, remove it for false and add it for true. Boolean coercion is useful when flags can be numeric. This is a DOM API contract for these XUL menu paths; other value-valued attributes and ARIA strings have separate contracts. Historical292 used setAttribute, so favor the newer implementation.

Scope: syntax DOM state.
